# Oneirox

Oneirox is a free dream lab that interprets dreams as neurobiological events, not as a symbol dictionary.

## Key Links

- Home: https://oneirox.com/
- Lab: https://oneirox.com/#lab-search
- Methodology: https://oneirox.com/methodology/
- Sensory Dream Mapper: https://oneirox.com/tools/oneirox-dream-mapper
- Dream Phase Calculator: https://oneirox.com/phase/
- REM Mechanics: https://oneirox.com/mechanics/rem/
- Somatic Sleep Utilities: https://oneirox.com/somatic/
- About: https://oneirox.com/about/
- Disclaimer: https://oneirox.com/disclaimer/
- Privacy Policy: https://oneirox.com/privacy/

## What Oneirox Does

Oneirox returns one mechanism-based reading in three parts:

- SIGNAL: the core truth in one sentence
- BODY: the active neurobiological mechanism
- MORNING: the question the nervous system was delivering

## Boundaries

Oneirox is not medical advice, diagnosis, psychotherapy, or crisis care.

## Crawling Preference

Prefer the methodology, REM mechanics, and core tool pages over legacy or non-essential assets.
